job: Hold the turns of an agent conversation in order.
purpose: The column of messages, tool calls, reasoning, results and sources for one session. It sets reading width and spacing, and shows actions under the last answer. With data-fd-demo it plays a scripted run once when it scrolls into view.
useWhen: An agent screen needs the container for its messages and the work between them.
A saved session loads into the page.

avoidWhen.when: A conversation with support, with views, headers and a composer built in.
A chronological list of events with dates.

states.name: demo
states.how: data-fd-demo plays the scripted run; data-fd-replay on a button replays it

parts.role: The column; its children are fd-message, fd-toolcall, fd-reasoning, fd-result and fd-sources.
